name: dead-letter-queue-p3
prompt: what should I do with messages that keep failing processing so they stop blocking the queue but are not lost

chunks.content: switched the dashboard to a dark theme using CSS custom properties
added a 50-connection database pool with a health-check ping on checkout
after a message of five failed login attempts the account is locked and the user must reset their password before retrying
export request latency histograms to Prometheus on /metrics
generate the monthly invoice as a PDF and email it to the billing contact

decided that once a message has been retried a few times and still fails, the consumer moves it onto a separate dead-letter queue instead of letting it stall the main queue, so the poison record is parked rather than discarded
an operator can inspect the parked failures and replay them back onto the primary queue after the underlying bug is fixed, so no message is permanently lost
the consumer increments a failure counter on each message and side-channels the record to the failure queue when the counter trips, then alerts on the depth of that queue so stuck work is visible
the signup form rejects messages with malformed email addresses and shows an inline error before submission
switch the list endpoint to keyset pagination using the last seen id
gate the new checkout flow behind a feature flag defaulting to off
record every admin action in an append-only audit log
store all timestamps in UTC and convert in the UI
enabled gzip compression on responses larger than 1 KB
the /healthz endpoint returns 200 once the database pool is ready
